Design7.io, based in Venturi Park, Hennopspark, is a technology and consulting company that combines financial services, payment solutions, customer loyalty programmes, consulting and software development into a single offering built around each client's commercial objectives. Per its website, services include full-stack and application development, UX/UI design and development, turnkey software solutions, change consulting, corporate and capital consulting, and human capital management. The company also runs a merchant services division, offering businesses multiple payment options and support aimed at increasing sales, and develops and manages customer loyalty programmes.

Design7.io reports having worked with more than 130 clients, completed over 40 development projects, built 86 strategic partnerships, and developed 11 loyalty programmes, positioning itself as a partner that brings together the right expertise, providers and systems to support business growth.

Dis-Chem Hazeldean Pharmacy operates from Hazeldean Square, on the corner of Silverlakes and Graham Road in Pretoria East, as part of the Dis-Chem Pharmacies chain, which has operated in South Africa since 1978. The branch offers a dispensary alongside the retailer's wider beauty, health, wellness, skincare and sport supplement ranges. Customers can use the store's Click & Collect service or arrange delivery through the DeliverD service, which runs its own delivery time slots through the week and on weekends.

Store trading hours run Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00, Saturday from 09:00 to 15:00, and Sunday from 09:00 to 14:00, with reduced hours on public holidays. As with other Dis-Chem branches, the pharmacy provides dispensing services alongside the retailer's self-medication centre offering, giving customers in the Hazeldean and greater Pretoria East area access to both everyday retail health products and pharmacist support in one location.

DWILO is a digital marketing agency based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, near the Kloofsig area, describing itself as bringing creativity and innovation together for businesses of all sizes. The agency's team has worked in digital marketing for more than 15 years, helping brands across different industries pursue long-term rather than short-term results.

DWILO positions itself as a full 360-degree digital marketing provider, covering technology requirements, creative work, strategy and media planning, so that clients do not need to source these services from multiple suppliers. The agency says it immerses itself in each client's business and customer base before developing customised digital marketing campaigns intended to improve efficiency and strengthen brand and product performance. Its stated approach centres on understanding a client's consumers, their needs and expectations, then building a tailored digital presence around that insight, from initial strategy through to the final creative and technical execution.

EBC Mobile Media is a Pretoria-based digital marketing business operating from Montana, offering a range of services designed to build brand visibility and generate leads. According to its site, these include digital business cards, search engine optimisation, website design and hosting, e-commerce solutions, Google Ads management, digital forms, graphic design and social media marketing.

The company describes its approach as using a variety of digital platforms to help businesses connect with target audiences, increase website traffic and reach marketing objectives online. Its team is presented as a group of professionals with varied expertise across the digital landscape, working collaboratively on client projects. The company's digital business card offering is highlighted as a way for clients to expand networking opportunities, while its broader service list covers both the technical side of an online presence, such as hosting and SEO, and the creative side, including graphic design and social media content.

items.description:
Ejenti Outdoor Factory, trading online as Ejenti Outdoor, is a Pretoria-based manufacturer and retailer of tents and outdoor gear, operating from Klerksoord. Its online store offers tents and outdoor camping equipment including camping chairs, camping tables, ground sheets, mattresses, stretchers, sleeping bags and umbrellas, along with camping accessories such as tent pegs. Beyond tents, the business supplies fabrics, upholstery materials, foam and sponge for cushioning, auto trimming supplies for vehicle interiors, filing and packaging materials, zippers and sliders, and gas equipment and accessories. The company also sells bundled camping packs, such as family and adventure camping sets for two to six people.

Ejenti Outdoor Factory describes its products as built for durability and performance for real-world outdoor use, positioning the business as a supplier covering both finished outdoor products and the raw materials and components used in tent and canvas manufacturing.

Eksteen National is an insurance claims solutions company based in La Montagne, Pretoria, with more than 20 years of experience in the insurance industry. The company positions itself as a partner for policyholders navigating the insurance claims process, aiming to simplify what it describes as an often overwhelming experience. Its services cover domestic building claims for damage to homes, domestic contents claims to help recover losses on household goods, and commercial claims, alongside other claim types handled by its team.

Eksteen National says its staff bring years of industry insight to each case, aiming to secure fair compensation and efficient resolutions for clients while emphasising transparency throughout the claims process. The company operates Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00. Eksteen National markets itself as a specialist claims handler rather than an insurer itself, working on behalf of clients to manage the practical and administrative side of making a claim.

Elarduspark Pet Shop And Dog Parlor is a combined pet store and dog grooming parlour operating from the Elarduspark Shopping Centre on Barnard Street in Elardus Park, Pretoria. The business is listed under both the pet store and pet groomer categories, reflecting its dual offering of pet products alongside professional dog grooming services. It is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, Saturday from 08:00 to 13:00, and Sunday from 09:00 to 13:00, giving customers weekend access for grooming appointments and pet supply purchases.

Customer reviews describe a range of experiences with the grooming side of the business, including trims carried out according to how customers specify their dogs should be cut. The shop serves as a neighbourhood option for pet owners in Elardus Park seeking both retail pet products and grooming services for their dogs in one location.

Emeris - Pretoria Campus hosts the Vega School programme within the wider Emeris institution, operating from Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria. Emeris was formed through the strategic evolution of The IIE's Varsity College, IIE MSA, Vega and the School of Hospitality and Service Management, which were brought together under the single Emeris name.

The Pretoria Lynnwood campus is described as newly refurbished and situated in an upmarket residential area known for its Jacaranda-lined streets each October and November, with good access to transport, nearby shopping and entertainment, and affordable student accommodation. The campus serves both local students and those from abroad, and offers a virtual tour for prospective students. As an educational brand of The Independent Institute of Education, Emeris provides access to Vega School's design, marketing and branding-focused qualifications alongside the broader range of academic applications and programme enrolments available across the Emeris network.

EnergyTechStore is a Pretoria East-based retailer of energy-related products, operating an online quote platform where customers can explore and request pricing across its range. Its categories include renewable energy technologies, heating and cooling, LED lighting, electrical products, and water storage and filtration, alongside solar-specific equipment such as all-in-one and portable power systems, low and high voltage cabinets, and power stations. The business operates from 08:00 to 17:00 and offers WhatsApp contact alongside its standard sales channels, as well as a dedicated registration option for installers and resellers.

Customer feedback referenced on the company's site describes staff giving product recommendations and troubleshooting advice on solar system limitations, with reviewers describing the service as responsive and the advice given as honest. The store positions itself as a resource for both individual customers and trade installers sourcing renewable energy equipment in the Pretoria East area.

items.description:
Enviro Bio-Chem is a South African agrochemical company based in The Willows, Pretoria, producing crop-protection chemicals for the agricultural sector. Its product range covers fungicides, insecticides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, adjuvants and rodenticides, together with environmental management offerings.

While its head office is in Gauteng, the company also operates out of the Western Cape and North West provinces, and has extended its reach internationally with branches in Kinshasa-Gombe in the Democratic Republic of Congo, in Lusaka, Zambia, and in Dublin, Republic of Ireland. This multi-regional footprint supports distribution of its chemical product lines to farmers and agricultural operations across several countries. The company's website organises information by product category alongside company background, team profiles, a quick guide and technical articles, reflecting a focus on supporting agricultural and distribution clients with detailed product knowledge across its range of crop-protection solutions.

Enviro-Insight is an environmental consulting firm based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, specialising in Environmental Impact Assessments and Environmental Management Plans for development projects across Africa. Its biodiversity survey work covers botany, mammals, herpetofauna, avifauna, invertebrates and aquatic fauna, producing habitat-specific inventories that feed into complete ecological studies. The company also offers GIS and mapping services using geospatial analysis techniques, customised software development for scientific and environmental applications, and ongoing scientific services such as monitoring compliance with environmental management plans.

Enviro-Insight describes its work as built on collaboration with other specialist consultancies, including soil specialists, and on maintaining close links with the scientific community while applying accepted industry standards. The firm states its aim is to support environmentally responsible development across the African continent, balancing growth with biodiversity conservation. Its own breakdown of workload shows biodiversity assessments for EIAs making up the bulk of its work, followed by GIS and desktop ecological studies.

items.description:
Eugene Marais Radiology is a private firm of diagnostic radiologists based at the Life Eugene Marais Hospital in Les Marais, Pretoria. The practice offers a range of diagnostic imaging services, including x-rays, ultrasound, mammography, bone densitometry (DEXA), computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). All imaging is captured and distributed digitally: patients receive an email link to view their radiology images and report through a secure, cloud-based storage system, which can be viewed multiple times and forwarded as needed.

Referring doctors are given immediate access to images and reports through the practice's secure online PACS system, and also receive a copy of the report by email. The practice has moved most of its processes to a paperless format as part of a broader effort to reduce its carbon footprint. Operating from within the hospital grounds, Eugene Marais Radiology serves patients referred for diagnostic imaging as part of hospital-based or outpatient care in Les Marais.

Euro Appliances Pretoria has operated as an appliance specialist since 1996, supplying luxury kitchen and home appliances to homeowners, architects and designers. The business describes itself as Africa's premium appliance specialist, offering renowned brands including Miele, Gaggenau, Liebherr and Sub-Zero.

Alongside its Pretoria showroom at Gift Acres Convenience Centre in Lynnwood Ridge, Euro Appliances also maintains showrooms in Johannesburg and Cape Town, giving it a presence across three of South Africa's major metropolitan regions. Customers can get in touch with whichever showroom suits their location to discuss appliance ranges and arrange viewings. The company positions itself around bringing trusted, high-end appliance expertise to discerning clients undertaking kitchen and home renovation or new-build projects, continuing its long-standing specialisation in the premium appliance segment.

Evotree is a digital studio based in Eco Park, Centurion, describing itself as a partner for guiding brands through the marketing and media landscape. Its service offering spans website and web-app development, including responsive and customised builds, e-commerce, WordPress sites and blogs or news platforms, together with app development for Android, iOS and hybrid or progressive web applications. Other services include SEO and customer analytics, covering Google ranking, Ad Words campaigns and heat-map analysis; graphics design covering logos, brand collateral and corporate identity; email marketing through targeted campaigns, digital newsletters and automated emails; and social media marketing across LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook and Instagram. Evotree also provides content strategy services, from research and planning through to curation and content management, along with UX/UI design for complex dashboards and user story maps, lead generation support, and hosting services.

The company describes its team as dynamic and solutions-focused, aiming to tailor its offering to each client's needs.

Exquiste Hair Salon operates from Shop 5 in Blu Valley Mall, The Reeds, Centurion, offering women's haircut services. The salon keeps extended trading hours through the week, opening from 9am to 7pm Monday to Friday, with shorter hours on Saturday from 8am to 5pm and on Sunday from 9am to 5pm, giving customers the flexibility to book appointments outside typical working hours.

Being based within Blu Valley Mall places the salon alongside other retail and service outlets in The Reeds area of Centurion, making it accessible to shoppers visiting the centre. As a hair salon, Exquiste focuses specifically on women's haircuts and styling, catering to local residents looking for convenient, mall-based hair care available seven days a week.

Facebook Business Marketing Masters provides on-site Facebook advertising and social media marketing services from its base in Monavoni, Centurion. The company builds tailored advertising campaigns and handles ad management, audience targeting and content strategy, aiming to boost clients' online visibility and drive measurable growth. Its stated focus is on small to mid-size businesses seeking a practical, results-driven approach, with clear and actionable recommendations rather than broad strategy consulting.

The business offers on-site services at its Monavoni premises, including a wheelchair-accessible car park for visiting clients. By concentrating specifically on Facebook as an advertising platform, the business positions its campaign work, audience targeting and content strategy around driving engagement and growth through Facebook advertising for smaller business clients in the Centurion area.

Faize IT Solutions is a 100% black-owned telecommunications integrator based in Wolmer, Pretoria, operating as a multi-disciplinary company serving government, corporate entities and the general public. Working within the information and communications technology sector, the business applies a best-practices approach to technology implementation, built on established processes and methodologies. Its design services include website design, logo design, letterhead design and business card design, while its support and on-site resources cover mailing, packaging, sortation, and printing and finishing work.

The company states its aim is to deliver services with minimal error and strong quality in an effective, efficient and economical manner, guided by a mission built on honesty and integrity, improving clients' productivity and return on investment, and offering flexible service tailored to each project. Its workforce spans a sales team, project management, software developers, technical services staff, engineers and support technicians.

Farmspace is a Pretoria-based agency marking ten years of work with South African farmers, providing agri-content production and marketing services for the agricultural sector. Through its farmer-focused platform, the company publishes videos, articles and event coverage on topics ranging from farm implement performance and cotton processing to community initiatives such as the Agri Relief Foundation's fundraising golf day. Much of its published content is in Afrikaans, aimed at farmers and agribusinesses across South Africa.

By combining ongoing editorial coverage of agricultural machinery, crops and industry events with commercial marketing support, Farmspace positions itself as a knowledge and community hub for the farming sector, connecting agricultural brands, events and causes with an audience of working farmers.

Farmwise Marketing has operated in the fresh produce industry since 1989, working as a procurement and packhouse operation that partners with farmers across South Africa to supply fruit and vegetables to the country's leading retailers. Based on Mann Street in Louwlardia, Centurion, the company sources and packs a wide range of produce, from potatoes to beetroot, focusing on consistent, year-round supply, quality handling and extended shelf life.

Beyond fresh produce, Farmwise operates a high-care facility producing ready-to-eat meals, diced vegetables and baked goods made exclusively for Woolworths. The company describes its approach as combining the mindset of a retailer with the values of a farmer, continually adapting pack sizes and product ranges to meet changing customer needs. With an established team behind its sourcing and packing operations, Farmwise positions itself as a long-standing link between South African growers and retail shelves.

FBRS (First for Business Registration Solutions) is a Bergtuin-based company registration and statutory compliance specialist serving attorneys, accountants and business owners across South Africa. Its services include CIPC company registrations, amendments, restorations and compliance submissions, alongside SARS tax registration and administration covering income tax, VAT, PAYE and customs licences. FBRS also handles COIDA/WCA workmen's compensation registrations and returns of earnings, UIF registration and monthly declarations, and payroll and HR administration such as payslips, tax declarations and labour contracts. Additional services extend to BEE, CSD and CIDB registrations, NCR compliance, trust registrations and legal contract drafting.

The company offers a free consultation to prospective clients and positions itself as a point of contact for professionals who need to streamline statutory registrations on behalf of their own clients, as well as for business owners registering or maintaining a company directly.

FICS is a Centurion-based company offering investigation and claims services focused on motor vehicle accidents, operating as a franchise with offices extending to areas such as Cape Town's Northern Suburbs, Ekurhuleni West, Ethekwini North, the Garden Route and Southern Cape, and Mangaung South. Its core offering centres on Road Accident Fund compensation claims, supported by merit investigations, which examine the circumstances of an accident often months after it occurred, and quantum investigations, which assess the monetary value payable to claimants or their dependents. The company has also developed its own app, used to capture vehicle and road accident data directly at the scene, creating a record intended to support future investigations, court proceedings and insurance claims processing.

Serving individuals, professional firms, corporations and parastatals across the legal, accounting and financial services industries, FICS positions its investigation services as a way to improve accuracy and turnaround time in accident-related claims.

Find A Business is a marketing agency based in Pretoria North offering content calendars, targeted email campaigns and multi-channel messaging for small and mid-sized businesses. The agency takes a practical, client-focused approach, building data-driven, results-focused campaigns designed to help businesses grow their visibility and engagement in clear, actionable ways. Its service style is described as professional, collaborative and responsive, reflecting a locally grounded approach to marketing support rather than broad, generic campaigns.

The business operates from premises on Burger Street in Pretoria North and offers wheelchair-accessible parking for visitors. By focusing on a defined set of channels, calendars, email and cross-channel messaging, Find A Business positions itself as a straightforward option for smaller operators who need consistent, tailored outreach rather than large-scale advertising campaigns.

FINLAW SA is a Rietfontein-based legal practice founded in February 2019 to help South African consumers address impaired credit records through debt review, administration orders, defaults and judgements. The company was established after its founders identified that close to half of credit-active consumers carried impaired credit and often did not understand their rights or options for improving their standing, particularly when facing court-driven enforcement actions such as judgments, administration orders or sequestration.

FINLAW SA offers services including debt mediation, credit clearance, credit evaluation and legal services, aiming to guide clients through alternative debt resolution options rather than lengthy and costly legal processes. The practice works on the basis that each client's situation is unique, tailoring its service offerings to individual circumstances as part of its stated goal of helping consumers regain financial freedom.

Listings handled by Fio Real Estate span a range of price points, from entry-level homes to multi-million-rand properties, including recently listed family homes such as a multi-bedroom duplex in Hazeldean. The agency frames its work around turning houses into homes rather than simply completing transactions.

Flowise is a software and app development company based at Eldo Junction in Eldoraigne, offering mobile app development, custom software development and web development services. The company positions itself as a partner for businesses that want to build a complete digital product, a standalone app, or need additional development capacity to augment an existing in-house team. Its mobile app development service focuses on tailored apps intended to give client businesses a stronger, more distinctive presence with their customers, while its software development offering is aimed at companies wanting to digitise processes, improve operational efficiency and enforce legislative controls regardless of company size.

Flowise's web development team builds websites intended to attract and retain visitors. The company also lists Flowcentric among its services, alongside general support for businesses looking to strengthen their digital presence.

Its stated focus is on brand identity, web design and digital marketing working together to help clients attract potential customers who are already searching online for similar services.

Client feedback referenced on the company's own site highlights fast turnaround on logo design and business card printing, as well as ongoing support for business re-branding projects. Future Branding presents itself as a partner for businesses needing both visual identity work and the physical branded materials that go with it.

Gener 8 (Pretoria Southern Region) forms part of the wider Gener-8 sustainable energy group, which frames its work around reducing household and business reliance on fossil fuels such as coal and oil. From its Monavoni base, the outlet supplies Victron Energy products for renewable energy applications alongside commercial and residential air conditioning units, diesel generators and fireplaces, giving customers both renewable-energy equipment and climate-control options from a single supplier.

The group encourages practical steps toward a smaller carbon footprint, including swapping conventional lighting for energy-saving bulbs and moving appliances such as stoves away from electricity dependency. For residential and commercial clients around Monavoni, Pretoria, Gener 8 acts as a local point of contact for renewable energy equipment, backup power generation and air-conditioning installations, drawing on the broader Gener-8 network's focus on sustainable energy solutions across South Africa.

Genesis Labour Brokers operates as a division of the Genesis Group of Companies, functioning as a labour-driven organisation that specialises in placing permanent, temporary and contract staff for client businesses. Through its Registered Labour Brokerage Service, the company manages employment contracts with placed workers, handles statutory deductions, provides industrial relations management and offers labour advisory services, alongside payroll administration. The company has highlighted recognition as one of the Top 100 Suppliers in the Motor Industry in 2008, as rated by NAAMSA's OEM BBBEE Preferential Procurement Subcommittee, pointing to a history of serving the motor industry alongside its broader client base.

Based in Theresapark, Akasia, Genesis Labour Brokers positions itself as an administrative partner for businesses needing flexible staffing, taking on the compliance and HR workload of contract and temporary labour so client companies can focus on their core operations.

Global Why Rust operates from Karee Street in Kameeldrift East as the authorised Waxoyl application specialist in Gauteng, serving the industrial, mining and export sectors. Its core offering centres on corrosion control and preservation, protecting assets ranging from heavy mining machinery to commercial vehicles through Waxoyl treatments applied to underbodies and cavities.

Alongside rustproofing, the company provides American mil-spec packaging and marking for equipment and parts, positioning itself as a provider of PPPM packaging solutions. It also manufactures custom wooden crates for export and local use and supplies cost-effective lightweight honeycomb packaging solutions, extending its work beyond corrosion prevention into protective packaging and crating for shipped equipment. Together these services are aimed at extending the working life of vehicles and machinery while meeting packaging standards required for export and industrial logistics.

Grootfontein Health & Wellness is a multi-disciplinary health and wellness facility based in Grootfontein Country Estate, Pretoria East, built around the idea that health is more than the mere absence of disease. The practice brings together a chiropractor, dietitian, clinical psychologist and counsellor alongside Pilates classes, visceral manipulation and craniosacral therapy, aromatherapy, and line dancing and hypnotherapy, all operating from the same site. The centre also hosts Body and Soul Fitness sessions and makes its venue available for events.

Beyond its own practitioners, Grootfontein Health & Wellness offers sessional renting to other health and wellness professionals who want to join the multi-disciplinary facility at favourable rates, growing the range of services available under one roof. The combination of clinical, therapeutic and fitness-based offerings is aimed at helping clients recharge, restore balance and address both physical and mental wellbeing in a single location.

Hamerkop Hardware is a hardware retailer in Rietfontein, Pretoria, offering a wide range of hardware essentials alongside gas, pet supplies and bicycles under one roof. Friendly staff assist customers with DIY needs, and the store accepts several in-store payment methods, including NFC mobile payments, credit cards and debit cards.

For items ordered off-site, the shop provides delivery, while its premises include a wheelchair-accessible entrance and accessible parking. The combination of hardware, gas, pet supplies and bicycles gives Hamerkop Hardware a broader everyday-needs role beyond typical hardware lines, serving DIY shoppers and households in the surrounding Rietfontein area. With both quick in-store purchases and larger hardware runs catered for, along with parking on site, the store is set up for straightforward, practical shopping for home maintenance and related supplies.

Harrop-Allin & Sons Pty Ltd is a fencing manufacturer and supplier based on Kuit Street in Waltloo, Pretoria, trading under the philosophy of staying ahead through innovation and an exceptional range of fencing products. The business traces its history back to 1947, when its first premises opened in Gezina on Voortrekker Road, initially supplying only domestic fencing before growing into its current operation. Its product range covers barbed wire, electric fencing, fencing mesh, gates, horse-riding fencing, palisades, posts and stays, razor wire, the Securi-Vue system, standards and droppers, and wire coils. These products serve a wide span of sectors, including prisons, military and public-place security, industry, agriculture, residential properties, sports facilities, aviaries and enclosures, mining, airports and stations.

Customers can request pricing through an online quote form, reflecting a business built around supplying both individuals and large institutional clients with security and containment fencing solutions.

Heartland Property Developers builds custom luxury homes under the tagline 'Love Where You Live', with a development portfolio centred on Waterkloof Ridge in Pretoria and an expansion into Cape Town. Its Waterkloof Ridge projects include Polaris Heart, a private cluster of ten free-standing 220-square-metre homes with three bedrooms and four bathrooms each, parking for three cars and large private gardens, and Sanford Heart Estate, a collection of seven contemporary, multi-level luxury residences with home sizes from 207 square metres on erven of at least 237 square metres, designed to work with the natural slope of the hillside.

In Cape Town, the company is developing Napier Heart, a boutique scheme in De Waterkant offering two premium lofts, fifteen studio apartments and ground-floor retail space. Additional developments, including one named Outeniqua Heart, are also part of the company's pipeline, reflecting an ongoing focus on designing lifestyle-driven residential estates.
